subject.title: feat(agents): add multi-pass context compaction with progress tracking

question: Should this PR keep an internal, unintegrated multi-pass compaction orchestrator in core now, or should it narrow to the already-wired pruning and summary-boundary changes until the architecture is ready?
rationale: The remaining blockers are mechanically fixable, but the larger choice is whether OpenClaw wants dormant multi-pass compaction architecture and internal settings in core before production integration, successor handling, and proof are settled.

options.title: Narrow Before Merge
options.body: Remove or keep private the dormant multi-pass surface, retain only the wired pruning/summary-boundary pieces, and leave the broader design to the open architecture issue.

options.title: Sponsor Full Integration
options.body: Keep the multi-pass direction only if a maintainer wants this PR to wire it into real callers with timeout, successor-transcript, upgrade, and real-run proof.

options.title: Pause For Architecture
options.body: Use the open architecture issue as the canonical decision thread and park this branch until maintainers choose the canonical compaction pipeline.

recommendation.title: Narrow Before Merge
recommendation.body: Remove or keep private the dormant multi-pass surface, retain only the wired pruning/summary-boundary pieces, and leave the broader design to the open architecture issue.

likelyOwner.reason: sallyom is the live assignee and best available routing owner for deciding whether to narrow, sponsor, or park this PR.
